{{Image}}
The '''Blacklight Territory''' was a [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]-strewn section of the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. The asteroids provided cover for [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and criminals that tried to avoid the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

It was the [[Blacklight Pirates]]' base of operations in this system.
